Two tables per modality: a feature-by-sample matrix of measurements, and a design table with one
row per sample. Nothing about the organism, the assay or the condition is assumed, and no column
name beyond the two below is required.

## What every modality must carry

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sample_id` | Unique within the modality, and matching the matrix column names in order. |
| `phenotype` | The contrast being estimated, on at least two levels. |

The phenotype is a condition of entry rather than a covariate. The estimand is a contrast, so a
modality that cannot express one cannot contribute to it, and a run whose modalities do not all
carry it stops with that named as the reason.

## What every other column does

Every remaining column is a covariate. A covariate the modalities share, and which varies in each,
sharpens the comparison; one absent from a modality, or constant within it, is dropped without
consequence. Nothing needs declaring in advance: a design carrying `tissue_source` and `donor_age`
anchors on those as readily as one carrying `strain` and `age_months`.

Two column names are treated as bookkeeping rather than biology and never anchor a comparison:
`sample_id` and `modality`. A column holding a distinct value for nearly every sample identifies
the sample rather than grouping it, and is dropped for the same reason.

## The vocabulary labels are read in

Cohorts assembled by different groups record the same thing differently. Untreated subjects appear
as `WT` in one deposit, `control` in another, `negative` in a third; sex appears as `male` and as
`M`. Nothing downstream can see that these agree, so a comparison anchored on the design would find
no level in common and match on nothing.

Labels are therefore put in one vocabulary as the data are read.

| Covariate | Resolves to |
|---|---|
| `phenotype` | `case`, `control` |
| `sex` | `F`, `M` |
| `genotype` | `carrier`, `non-carrier` |

The vocabulary holds only terms general across biology. Names particular to one organism, model or
study are absent by design, since a tool carrying the labels of the data it was built on fits
nothing else. A study whose labels are not covered supplies its own:

```r
registry <- chorale_label_registry()
registry$phenotype <- c(registry$phenotype, "apoe4" = "case")
registry$treatment <- c("drug" = "treated", "placebo" = "untreated")
se <- chorale_load(matrix, design, labels = registry)
```

A label the vocabulary does not recognise is left as it is. Two cohorts using different unrecognised
labels for the same thing share no level, which is a silent way to recover nothing, so
`chorale_check_design()` reports what a collection can and cannot anchor on before anything is
fitted.

## Genotype beside phenotype

Where a design records genotype separately from disease status, both are covariates and both anchor
the comparison: the phenotype carries the contrast the estimand is about, and the genotype enters
as one more term of the design profile. A study whose contrast *is* the genotype puts it in the
`phenotype` column, since that column names the role rather than the measurement.

## Organism and annotation

Nothing in the estimator is tied to an organism. Gene identifiers are mapped through whichever
Bioconductor annotation the study needs, and the curated vocabulary is retrieved for whichever
species it describes.

```r
feature_map <- chorale_map(rownames(matrix), from = "ENSEMBL",
                           orgdb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
gene_sets <- chorale_genesets(species = "Homo sapiens", db_species = "HS")
```

The lipid-to-pathway table ships with its compound annotation taken from one organism, and is keyed
on set names that are the same across species, so it places a lipid in the set a study of another
organism would use wherever that pathway exists there. A table of the same shape built for another
organism is supplied in its place.

## What must not be supplied

Batch-corrected and cross-modality-harmonised matrices are inadmissible. Identification consumes
the differences between modalities, and a correction removes the structure it depends on. Batch and
study belong in the design as covariates, where they sharpen the comparison rather than erasing it.
